cases.name: depth-positive

files.src/events.py:
from pymongo import MongoClient
from pymongo.client_session import ClientSession
from pymongo.collection import Collection
def consume(collection):
    client = MongoClient()
    session = client.start_session()
    ClientSession.start_transaction(session)
    return Collection.watch(collection)

cases.tradeoff: L3 requires attributed session, transaction, and change-stream calls in the same function component; service wrappers and split consumers are missed.
